paragraphs.text: Aranzhur is a plane in the Multiverse. It is the homeplane of Angrath and his family.
Aranzhur has a substantial amount of geothermal activity due to a multiplicity of volcanoes. It has a hot climate.
Jace Beleren mentioned the plane once, in conjunction with Infinite Consortium cells. It had a safehouse set up by Baltrice .

Aranzhur was conquered by New Phyrexia's Machine Legion and compleated . The Legion infected the flowing rock of the magma channels and came from beneath so that even most realized that they were under attack. By extracting the liquid metals from the lava flows, the Phyrexians equipped themselves with more and better weapons than the local blacksmiths could make. Nothing was left intact, until even what was broken fell to pieces. The magma channels were shattered, the reservoirs were drained, and the skies were darkened by oil and ash.

When the machines finally fell, the plane was nothing more than a great shell of frozen iron and burning ash. It still exists as a physical place, but it will be decades, if not centuries, before it can support life again.
Several humanoid species Minotaurs , often viewed as less intelligent.
